clean.title: Clean measurable win
clean.rationale: Primary lift is positive with a 95% interval above zero and healthy guardrails.
clean.limitation: Deterministic synthetic portfolio data demonstrates the method, not a production effect or Unity Sport result.

srm.title: Sample-ratio mismatch
srm.rationale: Assignment is inconsistent with the planned 50/50 split; fix randomization first.
srm.limitation: Deterministic synthetic portfolio data demonstrates the method, not a production effect or Unity Sport result.

guardrail.title: Conversion up, crashes up
guardrail.rationale: Primary conversion improved, but a statistically credible guardrail regressed.
guardrail.limitation: Deterministic synthetic portfolio data demonstrates the method, not a production effect or Unity Sport result.

novelty.title: Novelty effect
novelty.rationale: The early lift decays materially in later cohorts; extend the observation window.
novelty.limitation: Deterministic synthetic portfolio data demonstrates the method, not a production effect or Unity Sport result.

simpson.title: Simpson's paradox
simpson.rationale: Aggregate direction conflicts with both platform-level effects; audit allocation mix.
simpson.limitation: Deterministic synthetic portfolio data demonstrates the method, not a production effect or Unity Sport result.

exposure_bias.title: Exposure-selection bias
exposure_bias.rationale: Exposed-only analysis changes the estimate materially; preserve intent-to-treat.
exposure_bias.limitation: Deterministic synthetic portfolio data demonstrates the method, not a production effect or Unity Sport result.

L01.title: Can we ship Match Center v2?
L01.question: Is the primary lift credible, precise and safe enough to ship?
clarify: What is the randomization unit?
Is the primary metric defined before reading results?
Which guardrails can veto a win?
L01.evidence: Check SRM first, then confidence interval, then crash/cancellation guardrails.

L02.title: The dashboard says +lift, but allocation is 58/42
L02.question: Can the team interpret treatment effect when assignment is broken?
clarify: Was 50/50 allocation planned?
Is mismatch present before or after exposure?
Did eligibility differ by variant?
L02.evidence: SRM p-value is a trust gate, not another secondary metric.

L03.title: Conversion rises while crash rate regresses
L03.question: Should Product ship a primary-metric winner that harms reliability?
clarify: Was crash rate declared as a guardrail?
How large is the absolute regression?
Can the affected platform be isolated?
L03.evidence: A statistically credible guardrail breach changes SHIP into HOLD.

L04.title: The first week wins, the last week fades
L04.question: Is the effect durable or just novelty?
clarify: How long is the user decision cycle?
Are early and late cohorts comparable?
Was duration chosen before looking?
L04.evidence: Compare early and late cohort lift; do not stop at cumulative significance.

L05.title: Aggregate and platform effects disagree
L05.question: Which result should leadership trust?
clarify: Was randomization balanced within platform?
Does platform predict baseline conversion?
Was stratification planned?
L05.evidence: Audit allocation mix before averaging segments with different baselines.

L06.title: Assigned users and exposed users tell different stories
L06.question: Why can filtering to exposed users bias the estimate?
clarify: Can treatment affect exposure?
Was exposure measured after assignment?
Which estimand does Product need?
L06.evidence: Intent-to-treat preserves randomization; exposed-only is a diagnostic.

L07.title: Use CUPED without changing the estimand
L07.question: Can pre-period behavior reduce variance without leaking post-treatment data?
clarify: Was the covariate measured before assignment?
Is it correlated with the outcome?
Is the same adjustment applied to both variants?
L07.evidence: Report variance reduction and keep raw plus adjusted estimates auditable.

L08.title: Write the one-minute experiment decision
L08.question: Can you communicate result, uncertainty, guardrails and limitation?
clarify: Who owns the ship decision?
What is the absolute effect and confidence interval?
What monitoring continues after launch?
L08.evidence: Recommendation must include effect, uncertainty, guardrails and next action.
